013988:     // A call through a noreturn function pointer type ends control flow, and
013989:     // nothing after it in the block is emitted.  The defect that motivated the
013990:     // fixture only ever produced dead code, so running the program cannot see
013991:     // it: every shape in the fixture calls `must_not_be_reached` from a spot
013992:     // its noreturn call dominates, and the whole assertion is that the name
013993:     // reaches the assembly nowhere.  Clang's own -S output for the same file
013994:     // does not mention it either.
013995:     String8 noreturn_type_assembly_command_line[] = {
013996:         S8("-S"), S8("-target"), S8("x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"), S8("tests/basic_c_noreturn_type.c"),
013997:     };
013998:     CompilerDriverResult noreturn_type_assembly = compiler_driver_execute_invocation(
013999:         arguments->arena,
014000:         compiler_driver_parse_arguments(arguments->arena, (SliceString8)BUSTER_ARRAY_TO_SLICE(noreturn_type_assembly_command_line)));
014001:     BUSTER_TEST(arguments, noreturn_type_assembly.error == COMPILER_DRIVER_ERROR_NONE);
014002:     BUSTER_TEST(arguments, string_first_sequence(noreturn_type_assembly.output, S8("must_not_be_reached")) == BUSTER_STRING_NO_MATCH);
014003:     // The noreturn fixture also guards which declarations the marker is read
014004:     // from, and only the emitted code shows that: a call to a noreturn callee
014005:     // is followed by the terminator alone, while a call that returns reaches
014006:     // the store of the fall-off-the-end return value first.  The x86 backend
014007:     // emits both terminators as raw bytes -- 0x0f 0x0b is ud2 -- so what
014008:     // stands between the call and those bytes is what tells the two apart.
014009:     String8 noreturn_assembly_command_line[] = {
014010:         S8("-S"), S8("-target"), S8("x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"), S8("tests/basic_c_noreturn_call.c"),
014011:     };
014012:     CompilerDriverResult noreturn_assembly = compiler_driver_execute_invocation(
014013:         arguments->arena, compiler_driver_parse_arguments(arguments->arena, (SliceString8)BUSTER_ARRAY_TO_SLICE(noreturn_assembly_command_line)));
014014:     BUSTER_TEST(arguments, noreturn_assembly.error == COMPILER_DRIVER_ERROR_NONE);
014015:     // The marker has to reach a call through the declarator that owns it,
014016:     // through the specifiers every declarator of a list shares, through a
014017:     // later declaration of the same function, and through its definition.
014018:     String8 noreturn_terminated_calls[] = {
014019:         S8("call \"list_noreturn\"\n"),
014020:         S8("call \"list_specifier_first\"\n"),

015691:     // frame-address/alloca/signbit builtins, System V bit-field placement
015692:     // with an enum-typed field among narrower ones, a shift whose count is
015693:     // unsigned, and a narrow integer parameter whose register arrives with
015694:     // the caller's leftover high half.  Each source stays separate so a future regression names

015696:     // allocator because several are lowering rather than parsing defects.

000360: // The facts a translation unit consults a handful of times, held out of the
000361: // row every frontend call carries. CPreprocessResult is passed by value
000362: // through the parser and the IR lowering — roughly a hundred and fifty
000363: // by-value parameters, one copy per type-parse frame push, one per constant
000364: // initializer — and these six members were 548 of its 712 bytes while the hot
000365: // paths read only `tokens`, `spelling_base`, `target` and `dialect`. The data
000366: // layout is read three times per compile and the measurement tables only by
000367: // `-v` reporting and `-fsource-metrics=`, so they ride one pointer instead of
000368: // every copy.
000369: //
000370: // Null for hand-built results (the token-space literals the integer-constant
000371: // evaluator takes); `c_preprocess_detail` reads those as the all-zero block
000372: // their inline members used to be.
000373: typedef struct CPreprocessDetail CPreprocessDetail;
000374: struct CPreprocessDetail
000375: {
000376:     TargetDataLayout data_layout;
000377:     // Every file the preprocessor lexed, summed twice: once per inclusion,
000378:     // and once per distinct path. A header with neither #pragma once nor a
000379:     // recognized whole-file include guard is re-read and re-lexed at every
000380:     // #include, so their ratio is the translation unit's include
000381:     // amplification, and `lexed_files` attributes it per path.
000382:     CSourceMetrics source_lexed;
000383:     CSourceMetrics source_unique;
000384:     CSourceFileMetrics* lexed_files;
000385:     CPreprocessedMetrics preprocessed;
000386: #if BUSTER_INCLUDE_TESTS
000387:     // Actual include-identity table slot examinations for end-to-end scaling
000388:     // fixtures. Tests-disabled builds neither store nor increment this value.
000389:     u64 include_file_probe_count;
000390: #endif
000391:     u32 lexed_file_count;
000392: };
000393: 
000394: typedef struct CLexResult CLexResult;
000395: struct CLexResult
000396: {
000397:     String8 translated_source;
000398:     // Base pointer token offsets are relative to: translated_source.pointer
000399:     // for a standalone c_lex, the preprocessor's shared spelling space when
000400:     // the lex ran inside c_preprocess.
000401:     char8 const* spelling_base;
000402:     CToken* tokens;
000403:     // One byte per token, in the same order as `tokens`: raw CTokenKind for
000404:     // non-punctuators and a tagged CPunctuator for punctuators.  The
000405:     // preprocessor copies this projection into its final private stream.
000406:     CTokenShape* token_shapes;
000407:     CDiagnostic* diagnostics;
000408:     // Location checkpoints of the translated source, retained so a token's
000409:     // line/column recover on demand from its offset: the original-source
000410:     // location at each linearity break beside the translated offset of that
000411:     // break (see c_translate_source in c.c).
000412:     IrSourceCheckpoint* checkpoints;
000413:     u32* checkpoint_offsets;
000414:     // Page bracket over the checkpoints (see IrSourceRegion).
000415:     u32* checkpoint_pages;
000416:     u32 checkpoint_page_count;
000417:     u32 checkpoint_count;
000418:     // Spelling-space offset of translated_source.pointer (0 standalone).
000419:     u32 translated_offset;
000420:     CSourceMetrics metrics;
000421:     u64 token_count;
000422:     u64 diagnostic_count;
000423:     // Cursor into the checkpoints; location queries at non-decreasing
000424:     // offsets amortize to one advance instead of a search.
000425:     u32 location_cursor;
000426: };
000427: 
000428: typedef struct CPreprocessorDefinition CPreprocessorDefinition;
000429: struct CPreprocessorDefinition
000430: {
000431:     // An identifier, optionally followed immediately by a function-like
000432:     // parameter list parsed under the same rules as a source `#define`.
000433:     String8 name;
000434:     // The replacement list, taken verbatim: an empty value defines an
000435:     // object-like macro that expands to nothing, the way `-DNAME=` does. A
000436:     // caller that wants the `1` a valueless `-DNAME` means must spell it.
000437:     String8 value;
000438: };
